name: Gas-engine / genset installed cost benchmarks for data-centre behind-the-meter power (conflicting figures kept side by side)
description: Dated installed/package cost evidence for reciprocating gas-engine plants. Figures are deliberately NOT reconciled: scope (equipment, package, package+BOP, EPC installed) and dollar year differ by source. Rabobank and Nodus are analyst estimates; EIA is a government statistical aggregate; HTR is an analyst white paper; WWU/SGN is a consultant study; USP&E is an EPC/vendor planning range.

capex.metric: all-in capital cost, gas-fired reciprocating engine for BTM data centre (~2.5 MW class)
capex.basis: Analyst benchmark (RaboResearch). ~2.5MW-class natural gas recip engines for BTM island-capable installations; range includes genset plus inside-fence BOP, switchgear/paralleling controls, enclosure/acoustics, civil/EPC/commissioning and standard permitting; excludes fuel and major offsite utility upgrades. Stated as USD 1,700-2,000 per kW.

capex.metric: recip engine EPC / installed plant cost, grade A-C median
capex.basis: Analyst white paper, 8 grade A-C data points; low = 366 MW modular plant, high = utility plant with interconnection; 36-55 MW plants reported at $3,700-4,100/kW. Figures normalised to 2026 US$ using BLS PPI for turbines/turbine generator sets (2025 to 2026 x1.034).

capex.metric: recip engine package plus balance of plant, median
capex.basis: Analyst white paper, 2 grade A-C observations; PKG+BOP adds civil works, gas supply, on-site electrical interconnection and installation.
Single owner figure, grade B/C, package scope (enclosure, controls, emissions equipment); lead time 18-36 months.

capex.metric: capacity-weighted average construction cost, internal combustion engine installed 2024
capex.basis: US EIA Form EIA-860 actual installed cost, natural-gas internal combustion engines; 362 MW at new plants plus 86 MW at existing plants; excludes government grants, tax benefits and incentives. Separate all-prime-mover ICE figure is $1,490/kW.

capex.metric: CAPEX, internal combustion engine, UK data-centre on-site power
capex.basis: Consultant study for Wales & West Utilities and SGN, dated 02 October 2025: 'CAPEX cost for internal combustion engines is around GBP 390,000 per MW (excluding works)'. CAPEX spread over ten years in the cost comparison; excludes enabling works.

capex.metric: indicative CAPEX, reciprocating gas engine plant for data centre
capex.basis: EPC contractor planning range (USP&E, 24 July 2025), 'planning figures, not quotes'; low-NOx with SCR and oxidation catalyst; 6-18 month lead time. Not a contracted price.

capex.metric: implied installed cost, Meta El Paso modular engine plant (analyst arithmetic)
capex.basis: Nodus Partners divides disclosed $473m by 366 MW; analyst estimate, not a contract price. The underlying regulatory filing gives a different all-in $/kW (see McCloud item).

sources.note: Dated installed/package cost evidence for reciprocating gas-engine plants. Figur

gaps.what: Most OEM data-centre engine order values
gaps.why: Wartsila, INNIO, Caterpillar and Cummins releases disclose MW and engine counts but not contract value
gaps.next_action: Look for listed-company order-book disclosures or SEC/quarterly filings that state monetary value

gaps.what: Single consistent $/kW definition across all engine benchmarks
gaps.why: Sources mix equipment, package, PKG+BOP and EPC installed scope and different dollar years
gaps.next_action: Normalise scope explicitly before comparing; do not silently convert or escalate

notes: From the 10-year data-centre power retrospective (Power costs and contracts). Evidence-first 2016-2026 retrospective of data-centre power cost and contract evidence. Primary regulatory material includes the Texas PUC McCloud/Meta filing:
